svg.title: 03b · Kubernetes Infrastructure Architecture: Target
svg.desc: Proposed design. FSPs reach the cluster through DDoS/WAF and an external load balancer; operators through an internal load balancer. Namespaces ingress, mojaloop, stateful-resources and platform span three availability zones with replicas spread across zones. Registry, DR cluster, backup storage, Git, vault/HSM and SIEM sit outside the cluster. Sizing is a design decision.
svg.text: A proposed production deployment for a scheme operator: one cluster across three availability zones, Mojaloop Helm charts delivered by GitOps

The repository defines no CPU, memory or storage sizes. Derive requests, limits, HPA targets and Kafka partition counts
from runs of docker-compose-perf.yml and the k6 scenarios, then record them as decisions.
APIs: HPA on CPU or request rate · handlers: replicas ≤ topic partitions (one consumer per partition per group) · position
topics need enough partitions for the participant count (see packages/kafaka-partitioner-calculator).
Proposed design: nothing on this page exists in the repository. Product names (Loki, Tempo, Vault) are examples, not requirements.
